name: Decision network of two neural pools
question: How accurately does the population follow a weak bias when it is swept through its collective threshold, for N units and a given sweep rate?
assumptions: each selective pool is Npop independent two-state NMDA gates that open at gam H(x) and close at 1/tau: the source's mean equations, with the gates' own noise in place of its fitted Ornstein-Uhlenbeck current
the stimulus to pool 2 with 1 - c' (printed with + c' in the PMC rendering)
time in s, rates in Hz
the stimulus mu0 ramped from 0 to 25 Hz (the source switches it on at once); the spontaneous state loses stability at mu0* = 10.7 Hz in a subcritical pitchfork

provenance.source: K.-F. Wong and X.-J. Wang, J. Neurosci. 26, 1314 (2006), Appendix (reduced model without AMPA at recurrent synapses)

carrier.name: NMDA gating of the two selective pools
